expected_prisoner.name: Sunshine Appleby
expected_prisoner.description: Sunshine Appleby was jailed for ten days after a May 22, 1984 anti-nuclear protest at Electric Boat in Groton, Connecticut. Appleby threw blood on the steps of the administration building in opposition to Trident submarine production, was held on $100 bond, and was released when the charges were dropped.
expected_prisoner.body: Source: Nuclear Resister26, PDF3/printed2. Ten days of actual detention are explicit. No release day calculated from this total.

expected_cases.charges: May22,1984 Electric Boat anti-nuclear blood-pouring protest; charges subsequently dropped, individual statutory charge unverified.
expected_cases.sentence: Held on $100 bond for ten days until charges were dropped. This is reported actual pretrial detention, not a prison sentence. Exact release day unverified; release year1984 only and January1 is a storage placeholder. Source: https://media.nukeresister.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/NR026_19840802small.pdf#page=3

case.charges: April1,1983 Pentagon blood-pouring anti-nuclear protest; individual statutory charge unverified.
case.sentence: Sentenced June17,1983. Contemporary follow-up explicitly says Appleby served ten days after rejecting an offer of five days plus six months probation. Exact admission and release days unresolved. Release year1983 only; January1 is a year-only storage placeholder. No continuous custody assumed from April arrest. Source: https://media.nukeresister.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/NR019_19830823small.pdf#page=6

case.charges: April26,1984 Martin Marietta shareholders meeting blood-pouring anti-nuclear protest in Baltimore; individual statutory charge unverified.
case.sentence: Contemporary follow-up explicitly confirms seven days spent in Baltimore City Jail after pouring blood on corporate documents at the Martin Marietta stockholders meeting. Exact admission/release and sentencing dates unresolved; an earlier May25 scheduled trial is not treated as actual sentencing. Release year1984 only; January1 is a storage placeholder. Separate from the May22Electric Boat ten-day detention.
